t: A paid platform with ready coding environments, auto-graded work, and built-in AI assistants.
steps: Create a free instructor account or request a school quote.
Ask IT to review the privacy terms and the AI assistant settings.
Read the K-12 page for current pricing.
Build a course or adopt an existing one.
Connect students through an LMS or sign-up.
Check what the AI assistants can do and who can see the prompts.
Run a trial assignment with a test account.
